description:
**task** · parent: opi-ixp · **superseded by F3 (.51)**

Phase E — Compaction orchestration. Originally to land CompactionEntry append + `:session_compact` emit directly in `Coder.Session.compact/2`.

**Deferred** until F1–F3 (.49/.50/.51) restructure the per-turn lifecycle: Loop folds into AgentSession, Turn becomes a pure FSM, and compaction becomes a Turn transition rather than a side effect of `Coder.Session.compact/2`. Append + emit then live as Turn actions executed by AgentSession, with `Coder.Session.add_entry/3` handling the in-memory DAG + JSONL persistence (B4) — same target outcome, cleaner ownership.

When F3 lands, this ticket can either be closed or repurposed to track any residual Coder-side work surfaced during F3.

Original brief preserved below.

---

After `Compaction.compact/2` returns (or extension supplies a `%CompactionResult{}`):
- Append `CompactionEntry` via `SessionManager.add_entry/3` (B4) — which appends to in-memory DAG AND on-disk JSONL. Append-only — no history rewrite.
- Subsequent prompt assembly via `build_session_context` (B6/E5a) automatically picks up the new boundary and injects the synthetic message from E3.
- Emit `:session_compact` (fire-and-forget) with the appended entry and `from_extension?` flag.

Tests: port `agent-session-auto-compaction-queue.test.ts` (note: the auto-compaction-queue test belongs to F5/.53, not E5b's append+emit).
title: E5b. CompactionEntry append + :session_compact emit
